name: effort-phase
description: Sets main-loop effort per model request from the phase of the skill flow (judgment, mechanical, polling) and writes a per-step usage ledger

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Rewrite main-loop effort by phase. Off changes nothing and writes no ledger.

judgment_effort.title: Judgment effort
judgment_effort.description: Effort for planning, triage, implementation and review phases. session keeps the session's own setting.

mechanical_effort.title: Mechanical effort
mechanical_effort.description: Effort once a mechanical skill (finish, checkpoint, pr-update, ...) has been expanded in the turn.

polling_effort.title: Polling effort
polling_effort.description: Effort for a request that follows a step made only of wait-shaped tool calls (sleep loops, Monitor).

max_switches_per_turn.title: Max effort switches per turn
max_switches_per_turn.description: Cap on effort changes within one turn, 0 for unlimited. The probe measured a switch as cache-safe on Opus 5.5, so the cap is a fallback for a build where that changes.

ledger.title: Write ledger
ledger.description: Append one JSONL row per main-loop request to tmp/effort-ledger-<session>.jsonl under the checkout that owns the session root.
